content.comment_body: Is it possible to connect two [product_name] modules as master and slave? I am referring to versions 7 and 8.
Hello, please check out the following example related to [product_name]: [url]
I've noticed the examples demonstrate connections between version 7-7 or 8-8, but not directly between 8 and 7. Are these types of connections essentially the same?
Hello, Although I haven't tried this myself, it should be feasible. Consider reviewing guidance from our specialist: [url]

You can implement these configurations: Version 7 with another version 7 module as master/master or master/slave; version 7 with version 8 module as master/master or master/slave; and version 8 paired with another version 8 module as master/master or master/slave.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for definitive guidance regarding the compatibility of connecting different [product_name] module versions (7 and 8) using master-slave arrangements. Replies clarify that these combinations are possible, although official references mainly discuss same-version pairings, causing some initial confusion.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect confirmation or thorough documentation that connecting [product_name] modules version 7 and version 8 in a master-slave configuration is viable.
